title: YOU ARE PLAYER
body:
PLAYER PHASE
Players take Turns in Order
– 2 Actions each Turn,
until all Players have passed.

EVENT PHASE
1) Escape
2) Fire Damage
3) Intruder Attacks
4) Event Card
5) Bag Development

CLEANUP PHASE
6) First Player Change
7) Drawing Cards
8) Time Advancement
layoutNotes: Portrait-oriented card with a dark textured sci-fi frame.
The header '- HELP CARD -' appears above the title 'YOU ARE PLAYER'.
A large white numeral 6 is centered below the title.
Rules are arranged in three vertically ordered sections: PLAYER PHASE, EVENT PHASE, and CLEANUP PHASE.
PLAYER PHASE is blue; EVENT PHASE and CLEANUP PHASE are red; END OF ROUND is gray.
